messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered for gen-queue-usw-01. Impact: elevated latency and 5xx rate. Paging oncall (sam). Thread created 1766667777.

Sam: I'm on it — quick triage started. Initial symptom: queue depth + workers unhealthy, appears to correlate with a recent deploy to gen-scaling.

Jia: Thanks Sam. Can you draft a short statuspage blurb we can push as an initial notice? Need something conservative (investigating) + affected region.

Sam: Draft below, please edit.
```
Initial (now): Our engineering team is investigating elevated latency and errors affecting text generation in the US‑West region. Some customers may see increased response times or occasional errors. We’re actively triaging and will provide updates within 30 minutes.

Update (T+30): We’ve identified a regression in autoscaling logic causing underprovisioning during burst traffic. Mitigation steps are in progress; customers may continue to see degraded performance while we roll a fix and scale capacity.

Resolved: We've rolled a mitigation and confirmed normal request rates and latency across US‑West. No customer data was exposed. If you continue to see issues, contact support.
```

Amber_ops: For accuracy, current telemetry: 95p latency ~1.6s (baseline 0.6s), 5xx spiked to 3.2% from ~0.1%. Affects both streaming and non-streaming endpoints served from gen-queue-usw. Not seeing DB or auth errors.

Matt: Legal reads the draft. Please remove any definitive root-cause language from initial/update copy — "regression" is fine for internal but public text should be "investigating a provisioning issue" until confirmed. Also add the line: "No customer data was exposed." only after SRE confirms.

Sam: Updated public wording per Matt. New suggested update text below — shorter.
```
Initial: We're investigating elevated latency and errors impacting text generation in the US‑West region. Some requests may experience delays or errors. We'll follow up with more information and mitigation status within 30 minutes.

Update: Our engineers identified an issue with autoscaling that is limiting capacity during bursts. We're applying mitigations to scale capacity while we prepare a permanent fix. Customers may see intermittent degraded performance.

Resolved: Mitigation completed and performance normalized in US‑West. No customer data exposure has been detected. If you see lingering issues, please contact support.
```

Jia: Looks good. Two small asks: add ETA for next update (30 min) and a short internal note for customer support so they can triage incoming tickets.

Sam: Internal support snippet: "Impact: generation latency/5xx in US‑West. Start: 1766667777. Indicators: increased queue depth, 95p latency ~1.6s, 5xx ~3%. Workaround: retry with exponential backoff; prefer alternate region (us-east) if critical. We're scaling up capacity now."

Lauren: I can push the initial notice on statuspage if we have approval from legal and ops. Matt/Legal — can you confirm wording?

Matt: Approved provided the "No customer data" line is gated until SRE confirms. Remove absolute timestamps from public message; keep relative timing. Otherwise good.

Legal: Confirmed. Keep language cautious.

Amber_ops: SRE confirms no evidence of data exposure so far. You can include the no-data-exposed line.

Sam: Ok final: initial message published by Lauren now. Pushing to statuspage and sending customer email template to support.

Lauren: Published initial status update (statuspage id: sp_1766667777). Posted to statuspage and pinged customers with active incidents list.

Jia: Thanks — can we schedule the T+30 update even if no change? Prefer to post an "investigating, mitigation in progress" update.

Sam: Will post T+30 update. Current plan: scale up gen pool, rollback suspect autoscaler tweak if needed, then validate.

[~12 minutes later]

oncall-bot: Auto-update: follow-up update required (T+30 window approaching).

Sam: T+30 update draft: "We are applying mitigations to increase capacity (scaling pool) and observing partial improvement in latency; 5xx rate decreasing but not fully recovered. Engineers are continuing rollback testing. We'll post another update in 30 minutes or when service is restored."

Matt: LGTM. Keep phrasing 'observing partial improvement' and no definitive root cause.

Lauren: Posted T+30 update.

[~hour later]

Amber_ops: Mitigation rolled out and confirmed — 95p latency back to ~0.7s, 5xx ~0.15%. Service healthy in US‑West.

Sam: Draft resolved notice: "Resolved: Mitigation rolled out and service performance returned to normal in US‑West. We will continue monitoring. If you continue to experience issues, please open a ticket. No customer data exposure detected."

Legal: OK to publish resolved notice.

Lauren: Published resolved update and closed incident thread. :white_check_mark:

Sam: Thanks team. Post-incident action: create a short postmortem with timeline and autoscaler test coverage items. Assigning follow-up to Amber and Jia.

Jia: I'll open the postmortem doc and invite SRE/infra.

Sam: Closing notes: good comms, nice work getting the status updates out quickly.
